claims.text: The Palace Suites are located in the historical palace building and offer privacy for palace suite guests.

findings.quote: Located in the historical palace building, the elegant Palace Suites offer unmatched privacy only for the palace suite guests

claims.text: Apart from the Sultan Suite, the Palace Suites are maisonette-style duplex suites.

findings.quote: Except for Sultan Suite, 10 of the Palace Suites are maisonette-style with featuring rich, custom-designed duplex suites

claims.text: The lobby has large windows with a view of the Bosphorus Strait.

findings.quote: the large windows provide a stunning view of the Bosphorus Strait

claims.text: In the soap service the butler slices the soap for guests, giving one bar for immediate use and one wrapped in a pouch to take home.

findings.quote: marked by the butler slicing the soap for guests - one bar crafted for immediate use, another delicately wrapped in a pouch to take home

claims.text: Palace Suite guests can enjoy complimentary amenities such as homemade baklavas and chocolates, Turkish delights, fresh fruits and nuts.

findings.quote: complimentary amenities, such as homemade baklavas and chocolates, Turkish delights, fresh fruits, nuts, and snacks

claims.text: Every guest is welcomed by the Lady in Red, a host dressed in red with knowledge of the hotel and the local area.

findings.quote: every guest has been welcomed by our Lady in Red
Dressed in striking red, this impeccable host has unrivalled knowledge about the hotel and the local area.

claims.text: The hotel offers a guided history tour of the palace, narrated by a licensed professional tour guide.

findings.quote: On this exclusive tour, narrated by a licensed professional tour guide

claims.text: The Concierge team arranges private transfers to and from Istanbul Airport and Sabiha Gokcen International Airport.

findings.quote: offering seamless private transfer services to and from both Istanbul Airport and Sabiha Gökçen International Airport

claims.text: Custom-made furniture in the Palace Suites was inspired by Topkapi Palace, Dolmabahce Palace, Beylerbeyi Palace and Yildiz Palace.

findings.quote: Many custom-made furniture pieces were inspired by the Topkapı Palace, Dolmabahçe Palace, Beylerbeyi Palace and Yıldız Palace.

claims.text: The Sultan Suite in the historical palace has large sash windows, high ceilings and views of the Bosphorus, the historical peninsula, the palace courtyard or the park.

findings.quote: the Sultan Suite in the historical palace that offers a royal experience in line with local tradition, with large sash windows, high ceilings, and captivating views of the Bosphorus, the historical peninsula, the palace courtyard, or the park

claims.text: Palace Suite guests receive handmade 100% pure olive oil soap in four scents: mint-lemon-green tea, jasmine, orange flower and rose-lavender.

findings.quote: 100% pure olive oil handmade soap, available in four different scents; mint-lemon-green tea, jasmine, orange flower, and rose-lavender

claims.text: The hotel is in two buildings, a historical building and a modern hotel building, with a long Bosphorus shore between them; butlers provide a regular complimentary buggy transfer between the two.

findings.quote: As Çırağan Palace Kempinski dwells in two buildings, and there is a long Bosphorus shore between the historical building and the modern hotel building, regular complimentary buggy transfer services are provided by our butlers

claims.text: The redesigned lobby has a high ceiling with a Murano-style grand chandelier and locally produced tile art.

findings.quote: The redesigned lobby features a high ceiling adorned with a Murano-style grand chandelier, locally produced tile art

claims.text: Istanbul Airport is around 45 kilometers (28 miles) from the hotel, and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is around 50 kilometers (31 miles).

findings.quote: Distance from Istanbul Airport to the hotel is around 45 kilometers (28 miles).
Distance from Sabiha Gökçen Airport to the hotel is around 50 kilometers (31 miles).

claims.text: The hotel is split between a historical building and a modern hotel building, with a long Bosphorus shore between them.

findings.quote: there is a long Bosphorus shore between the historical building and the modern hotel building

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive palace setting.
